reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       CASE WHEN SUM(net_revenue_eur) >= 3000000 THEN 'A'
            WHEN SUM(net_revenue_eur) >= 2000000 THEN 'B'
            ELSE 'C'
       END AS tier
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC
